info.title: Travel Map API
info.description: Verified implemented E0–E2.4 contract. Same-origin HttpOnly opaque session; no bearer-JWT authentication. All private mutations require browser Origin + X-CSRF-Token. Swagger fetch transport obtains CSRF in memory and hides it from UI. OAuth/token flows reference-only. Try it out persists real local domain changes; no automatic fixtures/rollback. No Visit DELETE, restoration, invitation inspection, media or participant roster API.

get.description: Public liveness only; does not test database/Auth readiness. Other methods405 with Allow:GET.

Top-level navigation through Supabase Google-only S256 PKCE. Rate limited10 initiations/minute per rate key. HttpOnly encrypted OAuth cookie; no invitation token/returnTo parameter. Cross-site fetch initiation rejected. Use login link outside Swagger.
